_comment: scenario_perf's yardstick (round 14, squad Q2; verification.md rule 3): the median time of one reference sample (20 x ControlFixture.reference_work) per machine, recorded IDLE with `make ai-perf-nominal` (on builder0: make remote T=ai-perf-nominal). scenario_perf refuses to judge its CPU budget when the sample during the fight is more than 1.5x this. Keyed by /etc/hostname; flightdeck is the laptop. Each entry carries the commit, the load it was recorded at, and the date.

builder0.note: make remote T=ai-perf-nominal: 39 samples, ai_usec_per_tick 9575 alone. The provisional 0.819 (during a check at dca1d6cc) it replaces was 6% higher. At load 16.6 / 24 godot the same sample read 1.457 ms (1.88x of this).
